description: All-in-One Connectivity: The 10-in-1 design features one HDMI 2.1 port, one DisplayPort 1.4 port, one 100W max PD-IN port for up to 80W host charging, one 10 Gbps USB-C port, one 10 Gbps USB-A data port, two 5 Gbps USB-A ports, one Gigabit Ethernet port, and SD / microSD 3.0 card slots. Dual Display Support with Up to 2K@240 Hz: Drive a single monitor at up to 4K@144 Hz or 2K@240 Hz, or expand to dual 2K@240 Hz displays for ultra-smooth motion in gaming, editing, and streaming. (Note: Dual 2K@240 Hz output requires a host laptop USB-C port that supports DP 2.1 with DSC 3:1. Video output is supported through HDMI and DisplayPort only.) Smart Built-In Display: The built-in display shows real-time port status, charging power, data transfer speed, and device temperature. Upload your own images for a rotating slideshow, or press twice to start the customisable focus timer. Declutter Your Desk Setup: With 80% of ports facing the rear, cables route backward and downward to reduce the clutter common with flat hub designs. A 700 mm built-in host cable allows flexible placement while keeping the front of your desk clear. Web and App Control: Customise your smart display, track port status, and adjust the 25-minute focus timer settings on the web dashboard, or run photo album slideshows and firmware updates through the app. Compatibility: Works with laptops whose USB-C ports support Power Delivery, DisplayPort 1.2 / 1.4 / 2.1, and either USB4 or Thunderbolt 3 / 4 / 5. Supports Windows 10 / 11 and macOS. (Note: On macOS, both external monitors will display identical content. This device is not compatible with Linux.) What's in the Box: Anker Desktop USB-C Hub, magnetic base, safety sheet with QR code for the user manual, hassle-free warranty, and our friendly customer service.
